# Hookkapaani Studio

> Hookkapaani Studio (also written Hookkapani) is a kinetic sculpture and art installation studio based in New Delhi, India. It designs, engineers, fabricates and installs large-scale sculptures for restaurants, hotels, malls and public spaces, working in steel, bronze, aluminium and found materials, with mechanisms designed to be opened, checked and repaired.

Founder: Vishal Gupta, founder and lead artist.

Contact: hookkapani.15@gmail.com, +91 95400 26221, New Delhi, India.

## Pages

- [Homepage](https://hookkapani.com/): selected works, how a commission works, and answers to common questions
- [Commission for a space](https://hookkapani.com/for/spaces): kinetic installations for restaurants, hotels, malls and corporate atriums, and what affects the cost
- [Press kit](https://hookkapani.com/press-kit): studio and founder biographies, fact sheet, press coverage and media contact
- [Portfolio](https://hookkapani.com/portfolio): every work, with its category and materials
- [Case study: Corporate Atrium Kinetic Installation](https://hookkapani.com/case-studies/atrium-kinetic-installation): a suspended kinetic sculpture for a 9-floor corporate atrium, completed in 14 weeks including installation
- [Case study: Gallery Motion Series](https://hookkapani.com/case-studies/gallery-motion-series): three linked kinetic works for a curated gallery exhibition
